booking.confirmed.subject: Booking {booking_ref} confirmed
booking.confirmed.body: Your booking {booking_ref} is confirmed: {from_city} to {to_city}, departing {departs_local}, {passengers} passenger(s), SYP {total_amount}. Show the QR code in the app or on the website when you board.
booking.confirmed.sms: Masslak: booking {booking_ref} confirmed. {from_city} to {to_city}, {departs_local}. Show your QR code when boarding.

booking.cancelled.subject: Booking {booking_ref} cancelled
booking.cancelled.body: Your booking {booking_ref} is cancelled. Refund: SYP {refund_amount}.

withdrawal.paid.subject: Payout of SYP {amount} sent
withdrawal.paid.body: Your withdrawal of SYP {amount} was transferred to your bank account ending {iban_last4}. Bank reference: {bank_ref}.

withdrawal.rejected.subject: Withdrawal of SYP {amount} not approved
withdrawal.rejected.body: Your withdrawal of SYP {amount} was not approved: {reason}. The amount is available in your balance again.

document.rejected.subject: {doc_type} needs attention
document.rejected.body: Your {doc_type} was not approved: {note}. Please upload a corrected document.
